{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for -1 in customer_age
customer_age_negative_one = data[data['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {len(customer_age_negative_one)}')

# Check revenue column
print('\nFirst 5 rows of revenue (as string):')
print(data['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'\nNumber of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check for converted orders
converted_orders = data[data['converted'] == 1]
print(f'\nNumber of converted orders: {len(converted_orders)}')

# Check for channel distribution
distribution_channel = data['channel'].value_counts()
print(f'\nChannel distribution:\n{distribution_channel}')"}
